## Initial Release

### Features
- TUI Panel with real-time context usage visualization
- Enhanced compress tool with auto/range/topic modes
- Semantic compression with intelligent grouping
- Cost-aware pruning based on token pricing
- Adaptive thresholds that learn from history
- Session persistence across restarts
- Deduplication and error purging
- Topic extraction and smart recommendations
- v2-only plugin (keymap.registerLayer API)

### Installation
```bash
opencode plugin @serkanalgur/opencodev2-slim@latest --global
```
